sub_graphs.title: EIP-3198: BASEFEE Opcode Execution
sub_graphs.description: Models the EVM state transitions when executing the BASEFEE opcode

nodes.label: EVM Executing Contract Code
nodes.description: The EVM is executing contract bytecode and encounters the BASEFEE opcode

nodes.label: Fetch BASEFEE Opcode (0x48)
nodes.description: The EVM fetches opcode 0x48 from the bytecode

nodes.label: Read Block Base Fee
nodes.description: Read the base fee value from the current block context

nodes.label: Push Base Fee to Stack
nodes.description: Push the base fee as a 32-byte left-padded value onto the EVM stack

nodes.label: Deduct Gas (G_base = 2)
nodes.description: Deduct the gas cost of 2 wei for the BASEFEE operation

nodes.label: Stack Contains Base Fee
nodes.description: The EVM stack now has the base fee value at the top

nodes.label: Execution Continues
nodes.description: EVM proceeds to execute the next opcode

edges.label: Access block context for base fee

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly state the behavior of BASEFEE in pre-EIP-1559 blocks during execution
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume BASEFEE opcode is only valid post-EIP-1559 activation. Execution in pre-1559 context would treat 0x48 as an invalid opcode. This needs verification against client implementations.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'left-padded 32-byte value' does not specify endianness explicitly
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume big-endian encoding consistent with other EVM stack operations. The base fee value is placed in the least significant bytes of the 32-byte word.

implicit_assumptions.description: The base fee value is already computed and available in the block context before any EVM execution begins
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If base fee computation depended on EVM execution results, circular dependencies could occur

implicit_assumptions.description: The base fee value in the block header is correct and was computed according to EIP-1559 rules
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Smart contracts relying on BASEFEE for pricing could be manipulated by miners including incorrect base fee values

implicit_assumptions.description: Block producers cannot arbitrarily set the base fee and must follow the EIP-1559 algorithm
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contracts using BASEFEE for economic calculations could be exploited through base fee manipulation
